'''September 2000 Cedar Grove tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cedar Grove, NJ on 9 September 2000. [[Andrew Parks]] won it. It is known from Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1229">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00d1229/ cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-14-cedar-grove-nj-9-sep-00d1229/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Cedar Grove, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 26
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Parks]]
